title: scrapeforge run contract
description: Output contract for `scrapeforge run`. A run is only a success when it extracts at least min_rows records (counted before any --since filtering). Exit codes are part of the contract.
command: scrapeforge run <config.yaml> [--out <dataset>|-] [--min-rows N] [--sample N] [--since PREV] [--key FIELD]... [--snapshot PATH]

exit_codes.2: fewer than min-rows records scraped (an empty result fails loudly)

artifacts.path: --out value (default out.csv); - writes the dataset to stdout
artifacts.rows: every scraped row, or with --since only new/changed rows plus a `_change` column

artifacts.format: inferred from the extension, else the config `output:` key
